doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His father as a professional musician with day jobs
summary: His father played alto sax professionally but never left Dayton and held other work as well.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Which one, alto, tenor; what saxophone?
Now, your father, was that his profession? He was a professional musician?
Oh, my dad was a professional musician, yes he was.
That was his only job? A musician?

Well, that was his only job. He wouldn‘t leave home, so he did other work ‗cause there wasn‘t that much money in music for the professional men, any time, they would have two jobs. You see what I‘m saying? They would play, but then they would have other jobs that they did. And so that‘s what my daddy did, he played; play at night with his family band. And then he played at night with orchestras around. What is it?
